azure:container-apps.label: Azure Container Apps
azure:container-apps.reason: The snapshot has worker and environment artwork, not a general application icon. Use azure:container-app-worker only for a worker and azure:container-apps-environment only for its environment.

azure:content-understanding.label: Azure AI Content Understanding
azure:content-understanding.reason: No dedicated product artwork in the verified Azure package. The document symbol represents processing, not a Microsoft product logo; preserve the service label and non-document modalities in the diagram.

azure:voice-live.label: Azure Voice Live
azure:voice-live.reason: No dedicated artwork in the verified package. Keep session, control, audio and tool connections explicit rather than substituting another service logo.

azure:speech-avatar.label: Azure AI Speech avatar
azure:speech-avatar.reason: Use the Speech service icon with a visible avatar capability label; it is not dedicated avatar artwork.

fabric:iq.label: Fabric IQ
fabric:iq.reason: Show IQ as a labelled capability boundary containing its selected ontology, data agent, graph or semantic-model items. Do not equate the whole boundary with one item.

github:copilot-sdk.label: GitHub Copilot SDK
github:copilot-sdk.reason: Use the Copilot product icon with the SDK label. Show the SDK and CLI runtime as separate logical responsibilities, not standalone managed services.

m365:teams.label: Microsoft Teams
m365:teams.reason: The architecture package supplies generic content symbols, not Teams product artwork. Label the destination Microsoft Teams and show the selected adapter separately.

m365:sharepoint.label: Microsoft SharePoint
m365:sharepoint.reason: This document symbol is not a SharePoint logo. Retain the source label and its access boundary.

m365:outlook.label: Microsoft Outlook
m365:outlook.reason: This mail symbol is not an Outlook logo or an Exchange access resource.

m365:graph.label: Microsoft Graph
m365:graph.reason: This connected-node symbol is not Microsoft Graph product artwork. Label the API boundary, identity and permission scope explicitly.

m365:copilot.label: Microsoft 365 Copilot
m365:copilot.reason: This bot symbol is not Microsoft 365 Copilot artwork. Do not substitute GitHub Copilot or Copilot Studio logos.

m365:work-iq.label: Work IQ
m365:work-iq.reason: This organizational-context symbol is not dedicated Work IQ artwork. Keep the actual API or MCP connection and user-scoped boundary explicit.

logical:client.label: Interaction channel or client
logical:client.reason: Use the confirmed channel mapping when known; an application-owned UI has no vendor product icon.

logical:agent-framework.label: Microsoft Agent Framework code
logical:agent-framework.reason: A code/framework responsibility is not a hosting service. Show its selected runtime and host separately.

logical:tool.label: Authorized tool or integration adapter
logical:tool.reason: Name the actual adapter, owner and system of record; choose product artwork only after the integration decision.

logical:approval.label: Human review and approval
logical:approval.reason: Show the interaction surface, authorization and state transition rather than imply an unselected approval service.

logical:state.label: Authoritative state or checkpoint store
logical:state.reason: Use the selected store's exact icon at deployment level; logical state ownership alone does not choose a product.
